Sandbox_MilkIntoBarrelDurationMultiplier: Speed factor for the no-bucket milking (range 1-10, default 3.0). 1.0 = the game's base milking speed; higher = slower. ONLY affects the no-bucket mode (needs 'Allow milking without a bucket' ON and NO bucket in your inventory); with a bucket, the game's normal milking timing applies and this has no effect.
Sandbox_MilkIntoBarrelAllowNoBucket_tool: OFF (default): a bucket is required to milk into the barrel. ON (hybrid): you can also milk without a bucket - WITH a bucket you get the normal Husbandry XP; WITHOUT a bucket the milk still goes into the barrel but grants NO XP.
